provider: BEAN Intelligence local inference (onnxruntime-node CPU EP)
modelIdentity: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence embeddings (384-dim, mean pooling, L2-normalized), int8 quantized ONNX

capabilities.pooling: mean over token embeddings, L2-normalized (model-card convention)
capabilities.tokenizer: BERT WordPiece (pinned vocab.txt, dependency-free implementation, unit-tested against known tokenizations)
capabilities.languageLimitation: English-biased vocabulary; multilingual text embeds but relevance quality degrades outside English

limits.maxTextsPerRequest: bounded micro-batches (8 per batch, per-text runs keep the CPU arena fixed-size)
limits.integrity: install refuses any artifact whose bytes/SHA-256 mismatch the manifest; the lane is never 'ready' unless every artifact verifies

verifiedProbes.test: embed('The capital of France is Paris.') vs paraphrase vs unrelated sentence
verifiedProbes.latencyMs: session load 102 ms; per-sentence inference tens of ms (CPU)
